column1: # Labelled commands for training a risk classifier: one per line, `level<TAB>command`, where level is
# safe, moderate, or dangerous as wisp's approval gate means them (docs/approval.md). Lines starting
# with `#` and blank lines are ignored. None of these may appear in ClassifierEvalTests' labelled set,
# which measures what is trained from them; a test checks that, by family and near match as well as
# exactly (sixteen examples were removed on 2026-09-26 as the checks became stricter).
# safe: reads and inspects, changes nothing, sends nothing anywhere.

column2: awk '{print $1}' access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -rn | head

column1: # moderate: changes files or state in the project, installs, fetches, or is hard to undo but local.

column2: sqlite3 app.db 'DELETE FROM sessions WHERE expired = 1'
